learning_outcomes.text: Understand how automatic control circuits ensure a desired state or operation sequence in technological plants and processes.
Comprehend fundamental notions and examples of control problems in continuous, discrete, and logical control.
Understand the role and forms of the mathematical model used in linear theory of continuous and discrete PID control.
Learn methods of control loop synthesis and parameter optimization.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental notions, examples of automatic control problems
Role and forms of the mathematical model used in linear theory of continuous and discrete PID control
Methods of control loop synthesis and parameter optimization
Saturation of control actions, implementation problems
Principles of a control loop operation, terminology, transfer functions
bibliography: Šulc, B., Vítečková, : Theory and Practice of Control Circuit Design. CTU Monography, Prague 2004 (in Czech)
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
